specific_diseases_listed: Benign tumors, Cysts, Nodules, Polyps including breast lumps
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Indemnity and Benefit both. Initial waiting 30 days. PED waiting can be changed to 36/12 months. Specific Disease Waiting can be reduced to 12 months. Maternity Waiting can be changed to 48/24/12 months. Hypertension/Diabetes 90 days (covered after 24 months PED). Global Treatment 36 months.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Admission beyond 24 hours - up to SI above aggregate deductible
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Super Top-Up structure - covers expenses exceeding the deductible.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day Care procedures up to SI

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH inpatient treatment up to Sum Insured

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to Rs.2 lakhs for deductible Rs.5L and above (optional)

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Up to amount specified in Schedule (optional)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Organ donor's hospitalization for harvesting up to Sum Insured

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road Ambulance up to Rs.5,000/hospitalization; Radio Cab up to Rs.3,000/hospitalization; Air Ambulance up to Rs.5 lakhs

critical_illness_cover.notes: Personal Accident rider available (Rs.10L or Rs.20L).

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Unlimited Restore Benefit: Restore Base Sum Insured unlimited times during Policy Year after claim payment

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Stay Fit Health Check-up up to sub-limit in Schedule

room_rent_capping: Reduction in Room Rent option (Single Pvt AC or Twin Sharing) available

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Global Cover - Inpatient Care outside India for listed Illness/Procedures (optional)

notable_exclusions_summary: SBIG Health Super Top-Up is an aggregate-deductible top-up policy with Unlimited Restore Benefit and flexibility to change PED/Specific Disease/Maternity waiting periods. Covers Inpatient, Day Care, Domiciliary, AYUSH, Organ Donor, Modern Treatments, Home Health Care, and Global Treatment for listed illnesses. Optional Personal Accident rider available.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospitals; reimbursement via document submission. Pre-authorization TAT 1 hour; final bill settlement TAT 3 hours. Toll-free 1800 102 1111 (24/7); senior citizens 1800 102 1111.
available_riders: Hospital Daily Cash (Rs.500/1000 x 10 days; ICU 2x)
Global Cover (Inpatient outside India for listed illnesses)
